描述_EN: the small figures of animals and birds cut out on the gold leaf represent the daoist belief of a paradise inhabited by human beings and animals who never grow old. mirrors in china were associated with daoist mysticism as well as being a functional object in the house. most ancient chinese mirrors are made of bronze and it is very rare to find one decorated with gold leaf.
描述_ZN: 在金箔上剪出的小动物和小鸟的形象代表了道家的信仰，即人类和动物居住的天堂，他们永远不会变老。 中国的镜子与道家的神秘主义有关，同时也是家里的一个实用物品。 中国古代的镜子大多是由青铜制成的，用金箔装饰的镜子是非常罕见的。
